sentences.text:
BEFORE  HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE MALASRI NANDI  ORDER 20.06.2023 Heard Mr A W Aman, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and Mr B B Gogoi, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.
Page No.# 1/2 vs The State Of Assam on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192030639/
1 Page No.# 2/2 By this application filed under Section 438 CrPC, the petitioners, 1) Imanur Hoque and 2) Safiyar Rahman, have sought for interim pre-arrest bail, apprehending their arrest in connection with Golakganj PS Case No. 63/2023, under Sections 9/10/11 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, read with Section 376 IPC, read with Sections 17/4 of the POCSO Act.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the charge sheet has been laid against the petitioner in connection with the aforesaid case vide CS No. 181/2023, dated 04.05.2023.

Therefore,
the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the petitioner may approach before the learned trial Court and file an application for regular bail.

In view of the above, the bail application is disposed of with a direction to the petitioners to approach before the learned trial Court, within a period of 15 (fifteen) days, from today along with an application, praying for regular bail.
On such filing of bail application by the petitioners, the learned trial Court shall consider the prayer for the petitioner, as per the provision of law.
